steps.message: The fix is verified. Now I will submit the patch.

The issue was a regex in `rich/cells.py` that incorrectly limited the fast path for single-width characters to those up to `\u006f` ('o'), causing strings with characters from 'p' to 'z' and other ASCII symbols to use a slower processing path. I corrected the regex range to `\u0020-\u007e`, which covers all printable ASCII characters. I verified the fix with a test script.
